verses.original: וַיֹּסִ֙פוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּתְּנֵ֧ם יְהוָ֛ה בְּיַד־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·si·p̄ū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl la·‘ă·śō·wṯ hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh way·yit·tə·nêm Yah·weh bə·yaḏ- pə·liš·tîm ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh
verses.literal: Again the Israelites . . . did evil in the sight of the LORD so He delivered them into the hand of the Philistines for forty years

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ אִ֨ישׁ אֶחָ֧ד מִצָּרְעָ֛ה מִמִּשְׁפַּ֥חַת הַדָּנִ֖י וּשְׁמ֣וֹ מָנ֑וֹחַ וְאִשְׁתּ֥וֹ עֲקָרָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א יָלָֽדָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’îš ’e·ḥāḏ miṣ·ṣā·rə·‘āh mim·miš·pa·ḥaṯ had·dā·nî ū·šə·mōw mā·nō·w·aḥ wə·’iš·tōw ‘ă·qā·rāh wə·lō yā·lā·ḏāh
verses.literal: Now there was a man from Zorah named Manoah from the clan of the Danites whose wife was barren and had no children

verses.original: וַיֵּרָ֥א מַלְאַךְ־ יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ הָאִשָּׁ֑ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלֶ֗יהָ הִנֵּה־ נָ֤א אַתְּ־ עֲקָרָה֙ וְלֹ֣א יָלַ֔דְתְּ וְהָרִ֖ית וְיָלַ֥דְתְּ בֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·rā mal·’aḵ- Yah·weh ’el- hā·’iš·šāh way·yō·mer ’ê·le·hā hin·nêh- nā ’at- ‘ă·qā·rāh wə·lō yā·laḏt wə·hā·rîṯ wə·yā·laḏt bên
verses.literal: The angel of the LORD appeared to the woman and said to her It is true . . . that you are barren and have no children but you will conceive and give birth to a son

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ הִשָּׁ֣מְרִי נָ֔א וְאַל־ תִּשְׁתִּ֖י יַ֣יִן וְשֵׁכָ֑ר וְאַל־ תֹּאכְלִ֖י כָּל־ טָמֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh hiš·šā·mə·rî nā wə·’al- tiš·tî ya·yin wə·šê·ḵār wə·’al- tō·ḵə·lî kāl- ṭā·mê
verses.literal: Now please be careful not to drink wine or strong drink and not to eat anything unclean

verses.original: כִּי֩ הִנָּ֨ךְ הָרָ֜ה וְיֹלַ֣דְתְּ בֵּ֗ן וּמוֹרָה֙ לֹא־ יַעֲלֶ֣ה עַל־ רֹאשׁ֔וֹ כִּֽי־ נְזִ֧יר אֱלֹהִ֛ים יִהְיֶ֥ה הַנַּ֖עַר מִן־ הַבָּ֑טֶן וְה֗וּא יָחֵ֛ל לְהוֹשִׁ֥יעַ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִיַּ֥ד פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî hin·nāḵ hā·rāh wə·yō·laḏt bên ū·mō·w·rāh lō- ya·‘ă·leh ‘al- rō·šōw kî- nə·zîr ’ĕ·lō·hîm yih·yeh han·na·‘ar min- hab·bā·ṭen wə·hū yā·ḥêl lə·hō·wō·šî·a‘ ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl mî·yaḏ pə·liš·tîm
verses.literal: For behold you will conceive and give birth to a son And no razor shall touch . . . his head because the boy will be a Nazirite to God from the womb and he will begin the deliverance of Israel from the hand of the Philistines

verses.original: וַתָּבֹ֣א הָאִשָּׁ֗ה וַתֹּ֣אמֶר לְאִישָׁהּ֮ לֵאמֹר֒ אִ֤ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים֙ בָּ֣א אֵלַ֔י וּמַרְאֵ֕הוּ כְּמַרְאֵ֛ה מַלְאַ֥ךְ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים נוֹרָ֣א מְאֹ֑ד וְלֹ֤א שְׁאִלְתִּ֙יהוּ֙ אֵֽי־ מִזֶּ֣ה ה֔וּא וְאֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ לֹֽא־ הִגִּ֥יד לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·ḇō hā·’iš·šāh wat·tō·mer lə·’î·šāh lê·mōr ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm bā ’ê·lay ū·mar·’ê·hū kə·mar·’êh mal·’aḵ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm nō·w·rā mə·’ōḏ wə·lō šə·’il·tî·hū ’ê- miz·zeh hū wə·’eṯ- šə·mōw lō- hig·gîḏ lî
verses.literal: So the woman went and told her husband . . . A man of God came to me His appearance was like the angel of God exceedingly awesome I did not ask him where he came from and he did not tell me his name

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לִ֔י הִנָּ֥ךְ הָרָ֖ה וְיֹלַ֣דְתְּ בֵּ֑ן וְעַתָּ֞ה אַל־ תִּשְׁתִּ֣י׀ יַ֣יִן וְשֵׁכָ֗ר וְאַל־ תֹּֽאכְלִי֙ כָּל־ טֻמְאָ֔ה כִּֽי־ נְזִ֤יר אֱלֹהִים֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה הַנַּ֔עַר מִן־ הַבֶּ֖טֶן עַד־ י֥וֹם מוֹתֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lî hin·nāḵ hā·rāh wə·yō·laḏt bên wə·‘at·tāh ’al- tiš·tî ya·yin wə·šê·ḵār wə·’al- tō·ḵə·lî kāl- ṭum·’āh kî- nə·zîr ’ĕ·lō·hîm yih·yeh han·na·‘ar min- hab·be·ṭen ‘aḏ- yō·wm mō·w·ṯōw
verses.literal: But he said to me Behold you will conceive and give birth to a son Now, therefore do not drink wine or strong drink and do not eat anything unclean because the boy will be a Nazirite to God from the womb until the day of his death

verses.original: וַיֶּעְתַּ֥ר מָנ֛וֹחַ אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר בִּ֣י אֲדוֹנָ֔י אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֞ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁלַ֗חְתָּ יָבוֹא־ נָ֥א עוֹד֙ אֵלֵ֔ינוּ וְיוֹרֵ֕נוּ מַֽה־ נַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה לַנַּ֥עַר הַיּוּלָּֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·ye‘·tar mā·nō·w·aḥ ’el- Yah·weh way·yō·mar bî ’ă·ḏō·w·nāy ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·šer šā·laḥ·tā yā·ḇō·w- nā ‘ō·wḏ ’ê·lê·nū wə·yō·w·rê·nū mah- na·‘ă·śeh lan·na·‘ar hay·yūl·lāḏ
verses.literal: Then Manoah prayed to the LORD Please O Lord let the man of God You sent us come . . . to us again to teach us how to raise the boy who is to be born

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּק֣וֹל מָנ֑וֹחַ וַיָּבֹ֣א מַלְאַךְ֩ הָאֱלֹהִ֨ים ע֜וֹד אֶל־ הָאִשָּׁ֗ה וְהִיא֙ יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה וּמָנ֥וֹחַ אִישָׁ֖הּ אֵ֥ין עִמָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm bə·qō·wl mā·nō·w·aḥ way·yā·ḇō mal·’aḵ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘ō·wḏ ’el- hā·’iš·šāh wə·hî yō·wō·še·ḇeṯ baś·śā·ḏeh ū·mā·nō·w·aḥ ’î·šāh ’ên ‘im·māh
verses.literal: And God listened to the voice of Manoah and the angel of God returned . . . to the woman as she was sitting in the field but her husband Manoah was not with her

verses.original: וַתְּמַהֵר֙ הָֽאִשָּׁ֔ה וַתָּ֖רָץ וַתַּגֵּ֣ד לְאִישָׁ֑הּ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔יו הִנֵּ֨ה נִרְאָ֤ה אֵלַי֙ הָאִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֥א בַיּ֖וֹם אֵלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·ma·hêr hā·’iš·šāh wat·tā·rāṣ wat·tag·gêḏ lə·’î·šāh wat·tō·mer ’ê·lāw hin·nêh nir·’āh ’ê·lay hā·’îš ’ă·šer- bā ḇay·yō·wm ’ê·lāy
verses.literal: The woman ran . . . quickly to tell her husband Behold the man who came to me the other day has reappeared . . .

verses.original: וַיָּ֛קָם וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ מָנ֖וֹחַ אַחֲרֵ֣י אִשְׁתּ֑וֹ וַיָּבֹא֙ אֶל־ הָאִ֔ישׁ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ הַאַתָּ֥ה הָאִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבַּ֥רְתָּ אֶל־ הָאִשָּׁ֖ה וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אָֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām way·yê·leḵ mā·nō·w·aḥ ’a·ḥă·rê ’iš·tōw way·yā·ḇō ’el- hā·’îš way·yō·mer lōw ha·’at·tāh hā·’îš ’ă·šer- dib·bar·tā ’el- hā·’iš·šāh way·yō·mer ’ā·nî
verses.literal: So Manoah got up and followed . . . his wife When he came to the man he asked Are you the man who spoke to my wife I am, ” he said

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מָנ֔וֹחַ עַתָּ֖ה יָבֹ֣א דְבָרֶ֑יךָ מַה־ יִּֽהְיֶ֥ה מִשְׁפַּט־ הַנַּ֖עַר וּמַעֲשֵֽׂהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mā·nō·w·aḥ ‘at·tāh yā·ḇō ḏə·ḇā·re·ḵā mah- yih·yeh miš·paṭ- han·na·‘ar ū·ma·‘ă·śê·hū
verses.literal: Then Manoah asked When your words come to pass what will be the boy’s rule of life and mission

verses.original: וַיֹּ֛אמֶר מַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מָנ֑וֹחַ מִכֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ אָמַ֥רְתִּי אֶל־ הָאִשָּׁ֖ה תִּשָּׁמֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mal·’aḵ Yah·weh ’el- mā·nō·w·aḥ mik·kōl ’ă·šer- ’ā·mar·tî ’el- hā·’iš·šāh tiš·šā·mêr
verses.literal: So the angel of the LORD . . . answered Manoah Your wife is to do everything I told her . . .

verses.original: מִכֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־ יֵצֵא֩ מִגֶּ֨פֶן הַיַּ֜יִן לֹ֣א תֹאכַ֗ל וְיַ֤יִן וְשֵׁכָר֙ אַל־ תֵּ֔שְׁתְּ וְכָל־ טֻמְאָ֖ה אַל־ תֹּאכַ֑ל כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוִּיתִ֖יהָ תִּשְׁמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: mik·kōl ’ă·šer- yê·ṣê mig·ge·p̄en hay·ya·yin lō ṯō·ḵal wə·ya·yin wə·šê·ḵār ’al- tê·šət wə·ḵāl ṭum·’āh ’al- tō·ḵal kōl ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wî·ṯî·hā tiš·mōr
verses.literal: She must not eat anything that comes from the vine . . . nor drink any wine or strong drink nor eat anything unclean . . . She must do everything I have commanded her

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מָנ֖וֹחַ אֶל־ מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֑ה נַעְצְרָה־ נָּ֣א אוֹתָ֔ךְ וְנַעֲשֶׂ֥ה לְפָנֶ֖יךָ גְּדִ֥י עִזִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mā·nō·w·aḥ ’el- mal·’aḵ Yah·weh na‘·ṣə·rāh- nā ’ō·w·ṯāḵ wə·na·‘ă·śeh lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā gə·ḏî ‘iz·zîm
verses.literal: Please stay here Manoah . . . said to the angel of the LORD and we will prepare a young goat . . . for you

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ מַלְאַ֨ךְ יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ מָנ֗וֹחַ אִם־ תַּעְצְרֵ֙נִי֙ לֹא־ אֹכַ֣ל בְּלַחְמֶ֔ךָ וְאִם־ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה עֹלָ֔ה לַיהוָ֖ה תַּעֲלֶ֑נָּה כִּ֚י לֹא־ יָדַ֣ע מָנ֔וֹחַ כִּֽי־ מַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָ֖ה הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mal·’aḵ Yah·weh ’el- mā·nō·w·aḥ ’im- ta‘·ṣə·rê·nî lō- ’ō·ḵal bə·laḥ·me·ḵā wə·’im- ta·‘ă·śeh ‘ō·lāh Yah·weh ta·‘ă·len·nāh kî lō- yā·ḏa‘ mā·nō·w·aḥ kî- mal·’aḵ Yah·weh hū
verses.literal: And the angel of the LORD replied Even if I stay I will not eat your food But if you prepare a burnt offering offer it to the LORD For Manoah . . . did not know that it was the angel of the LORD

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר מָנ֛וֹחַ אֶל־ מַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָ֖ה מִ֣י שְׁמֶ֑ךָ כִּֽי־ יָבֹ֥א דִבְרֶיךָ וְכִבַּדְנֽוּךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mā·nō·w·aḥ ’el- mal·’aḵ Yah·weh mî šə·me·ḵā kî- yā·ḇō ḏiḇ·rɛ·ḵå̄ wə·ḵib·baḏ·nū·ḵā
verses.literal: Then Manoah said to the angel of the LORD What is your name so that we may honor you when your word comes to pass

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לּוֹ֙ מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה לָ֥מָּה זֶּ֖ה תִּשְׁאַ֣ל לִשְׁמִ֑י וְהוּא־ פֶ֛לִאי׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lō mal·’aḵ Yah·weh lām·māh zeh tiš·’al liš·mî wə·hū- p̄ɛ·li
verses.literal: Why . . . do you ask my name said the angel of the LORD since it is beyond comprehension

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח מָנ֜וֹחַ אֶת־ גְּדִ֤י הָעִזִּים֙ וְאֶת־ הַמִּנְחָ֔ה וַיַּ֥עַל עַל־ הַצּ֖וּר לַֽיהוָ֑ה וּמַפְלִ֣א לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת וּמָנ֥וֹחַ וְאִשְׁתּ֖וֹ רֹאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ mā·nō·w·aḥ ’eṯ- gə·ḏî hā·‘iz·zîm wə·’eṯ- ham·min·ḥāh way·ya·‘al ‘al- haṣ·ṣūr Yah·weh ū·map̄·li la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ū·mā·nō·w·aḥ wə·’iš·tōw rō·’îm
verses.literal: Then Manoah took a young goat . . . and a grain offering and offered them on a rock to the LORD And as Manoah and his wife looked on the LORD did a marvelous thing

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ בַעֲל֨וֹת הַלַּ֜הַב מֵעַ֤ל הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ הַשָּׁמַ֔יְמָה וַיַּ֥עַל מַלְאַךְ־ יְהוָ֖ה בְּלַ֣הַב הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וּמָנ֤וֹחַ וְאִשְׁתּוֹ֙ רֹאִ֔ים וַיִּפְּל֥וּ עַל־ פְּנֵיהֶ֖ם אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḇa·‘ă·lō·wṯ hal·la·haḇ mê·‘al ham·miz·bê·aḥ haš·šā·may·māh way·ya·‘al mal·’aḵ- Yah·weh bə·la·haḇ ham·miz·bê·aḥ ū·mā·nō·w·aḥ wə·’iš·tōw rō·’îm way·yip·pə·lū ‘al- pə·nê·hem ’ā·rə·ṣāh
verses.literal: When the flame went up from the altar to the sky the angel of the LORD ascended in the flame When Manoah and his wife saw this they fell facedown . . . to the ground

verses.original: וְלֹא־ יָ֤סַף עוֹד֙ מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה לְהֵרָאֹ֖ה אֶל־ מָנ֣וֹחַ וְאֶל־ אִשְׁתּ֑וֹ אָ֚ז יָדַ֣ע מָנ֔וֹחַ כִּֽי־ מַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָ֖ה הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- yā·sap̄ ‘ō·wḏ mal·’aḵ Yah·weh lə·hê·rā·’ōh ’el- mā·nō·w·aḥ wə·’el- ’iš·tōw ’āz yā·ḏa‘ mā·nō·w·aḥ kî- mal·’aḵ Yah·weh hū
verses.literal: And when the angel of the LORD did not appear again . . . to Manoah and his wife Manoah realized that it had been the angel of the LORD

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר מָנ֛וֹחַ אֶל־ אִשְׁתּ֖וֹ מ֣וֹת נָמ֑וּת כִּ֥י אֱלֹהִ֖ים רָאִֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mā·nō·w·aḥ ’el- ’iš·tōw mō·wṯ nā·mūṯ kî ’ĕ·lō·hîm rā·’î·nū
verses.literal: We are going to die . . . he said to his wife for we have seen God

verses.original: וַתֹּ֧אמֶר ל֣וֹ אִשְׁתּ֗וֹ לוּ֩ חָפֵ֨ץ יְהוָ֤ה לַהֲמִיתֵ֙נוּ֙ לֹֽא־ לָקַ֤ח מִיָּדֵ֙נוּ֙ עֹלָ֣ה וּמִנְחָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א הֶרְאָ֖נוּ אֶת־ כָּל־ אֵ֑לֶּה וְכָעֵ֕ת לֹ֥א הִשְׁמִיעָ֖נוּ כָּזֹֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer lōw ’iš·tōw lū ḥā·p̄êṣ Yah·weh la·hă·mî·ṯê·nū lō- lā·qaḥ mî·yā·ḏê·nū ‘ō·lāh ū·min·ḥāh wə·lō her·’ā·nū ’eṯ- kāl- ’êl·leh wə·ḵā·‘êṯ lō hiš·mî·‘ā·nū kā·zōṯ
verses.literal: But his wife replied If the LORD had intended to kill us He would not have accepted the burnt offering and the grain offering from our hands nor would He have shown us all these things or spoken to us . . . this way

verses.original: וַתֵּ֤לֶד הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ בֵּ֔ן וַתִּקְרָ֥א אֶת־ שְׁמ֖וֹ שִׁמְשׁ֑וֹן וַיִּגְדַּ֣ל הַנַּ֔עַר וַֽיְבָרְכֵ֖הוּ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·leḏ hā·’iš·šāh bên wat·tiq·rā ’eṯ- šə·mōw šim·šō·wn way·yiḡ·dal han·na·‘ar way·ḇā·rə·ḵê·hū Yah·weh
verses.literal: So the woman gave birth to a son and named him Samson The boy grew and the LORD blessed him

verses.original: וַתָּ֙חֶל֙ ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֔ה לְפַעֲמ֖וֹ בְּמַחֲנֵה־ דָ֑ן בֵּ֥ין צָרְעָ֖ה וּבֵ֥ין אֶשְׁתָּאֹֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·ḥel rū·aḥ Yah·weh lə·p̄a·‘ă·mōw bə·ma·ḥă·nêh- ḏān bên ṣā·rə·‘āh ū·ḇên ’eš·tā·’ōl
verses.literal: And the Spirit of the LORD began to stir him at Mahaneh-dan . . . between Zorah . . . and Eshtaol
